text:
liyuan: quick idea 5m morning sync5 5 can we surface prefetched-cache-adjusted cost on the tenant card? want a tiny diff: raw vs "amortized" so product owners see impact immediately.

tom: yes please. would be helpful to see a single percent delta next to total burn + an optional expanded view with per-route rows. keeps card compact.

anya: implementation Q: how do we split shared prefetch credit? naive split by distinct sessions in window or weighted by requests?

oliver: weighting seems better. propose: for each prefetch payload, allocate its token_count across sessions that reused it, weighted by that session's subsequent token consumption in the same window. keeps credit with heavy users.

liyuan: sounds good. put it in the RFC as "session-weighted amortization". also note sticky routing: the amortization key should be (route_id, model_version, prefetch_key_digest).

tom: UX: show 3 things on the card: total_tokens, amortized_tokens, savings_pct. savings_pct tooltip explains method and links to docs. small sparkline for last 24h.

anya: data side: we can emit an amortized_tokens metric at 60s granularity into TSDB. keep raw events in the event-store for exact recompute.

oliver: if we materialize, we must persist the allocation table or a deterministic hash so reruns produce same splits after data backfills. otherwise billing/alerts mismatch.

infra-bot: scheduled job created: cost/amortize-window-1m -> daily-run. (id: SJ-1291)

liyuan: alerting: ops wants a noisy-signal detection: if amortized_savings changes by >25% vs previous 15m, fire an investigation alert.

tom: regarding canary sim: product wants "what-if" where they pick a route split perc and we show projected savings. how heavy is that compute?

anya: we can do a cheap approximation by replaying sampled traces and scaling them to the proposed split. accuracy ~95% for most workloads at 1% sample. cost: a few CPU-minutes per sim. acceptable as a preview.

oliver: add caveat in UI: "approximate preview based on sampled traces" and add a link to run full sim (longer).

liyuan: edge-case: if a model sku has different per-token price (quantized vs fp16), amortization must use price-per-token not just token counts. include price metadata in materialized metric.

tom: agreed. show both "tokens" and "normalized USD" on hover.

anya: actionables: 1) implement 1m amortized_tokens in TSDB, include price-per-token; 2) add tenant card UI with savings_pct + expand per-route; 3) build sample-based canary preview API; 4) create alert rule for big swings.

oliver: I'll own (1) and (3) infra work. any objections to materializing at 60s? reduces API latency.

liyuan: no objections. tom/anya will own UI and sampling sim. infra-bot, tag tasks to me/oliver/tom/anya.

infra-bot: tasks created: CP-552 (materialize amortized tokens), CP-553 (canary preview API), CP-554 (tenant card UI).

tom: one more: track audit fields so we can explain attribution per-window (which prefetches were split, which sessions credited). helpful for customer queries.

anya: logging plan: emit attribution map for top-N prefetches per-window to s3 for 7d retention. small JSON blobs.

liyuan: nice. ok wrapping. last_message: 3245678965
